name: Public section pages and image-only games gallery
description: Verifies visitors can navigate the separate public sections and open a game image to see its details.
steps: Open the homepage and select Games
Confirm the game gallery shows image tiles without titles or prices
Open a game tile
expected: A separate Games page is shown, tiles are image-only, and opening a tile shows game details and price.

name: Owner can create, edit and delete content with durable state
description: Verifies owner content management supports the full CRUD lifecycle and saves changes across reloads.
steps: Sign in with the owner account
Create a new event with a title and description
Edit the event details and save
Refresh and confirm the updated details
Delete the event and confirm
expected: The event can be created, edited, retained after refresh, and deleted; non-owners cannot perform owner-only content writes.

name: Device image upload gives success or a finite error
description: Verifies device image uploads attach to content when successful and failures do not leave the UI loading forever.
steps: Open the owner dashboard on mobile
Select a valid image smaller than 4 MB
Publish a content item using the uploaded image
Try an unsupported or oversized image
expected: Successful uploads can be published and remain visible after refresh; invalid files or failed requests show an error and stop the loading state.

name: Purchase request lifecycle and private buyer history
description: Verifies a signed-in buyer can create a pending request, the owner can decide it and the buyer sees instructions for approved requests.
steps: Open a game and select Buy Now while signed out
Sign in and submit the request
Confirm it appears as Pending in My Purchase Requests
As owner, approve it and enter next-step instructions
Return to the buyer request list
expected: The request is persisted with the signed-in buyer, starts Pending, and displays the owner-provided instructions after approval; buyers cannot see other users' requests.

name: Owner dashboard metrics and staff permission boundaries
description: Verifies the owner can review dashboard counts and manage staff permissions while unauthorized users are denied.
steps: Sign in as the owner and open the dashboard
Review page views, account, staff and pending-request counts
Grant a test member a limited staff permission
Attempt an owner-only action as that staff member
expected: Dashboard counts are based on recorded data, staff permissions are saved, and a staff account cannot perform actions outside its assigned permissions.
